hypotheses.persona: Single professional working regular office hours
hypotheses.rationale: The weekend observations show a different pattern from weekdays - object_16 remains at receptacle_12 throughout the day (07:12 and 12:25), suggesting no work-related departure. The evening activity at 21:45 continues, but with object_16 also moving to receptacle_6, indicating a more relaxed weekend routine. This strongly supports the professional work hypothesis with distinct weekend behavior.

The structured weekday pattern and now distinct weekend behavior make this less likely. A student might have more variable weekend activities, but the consistent evening timing still suggests some structure.
The clear distinction between weekday and weekend patterns makes remote work less likely, as remote workers typically maintain more consistent schedules across days.
